title: Security headers and Content-Security-Policy

requirements.text: Responses carry conservative defaults: CSP, HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP and frame protection
Inline scripts are allowed only by a fresh random per-request nonce
A CSP can be rolled out in report-only mode before it is enforced
Directive names and values are validated so header or directive injection is refused
HSTS is configurable and preload is opt-in only with its prerequisites
Headers are applied without breaking bodies, status, redirects or explicitly set headers
CSP violation reports are accepted at a size-limited endpoint and recorded

evidence.name: nonce is random base64 and injected into script-src
report-only moves CSP to the report-only header
directive injection and unsafe values are rejected
HSTS is configurable and preload is opt-in with prerequisites
withSecurityHeaders preserves body, status, and existing headers unless override
withSecurityHeaders works on immutable redirect responses

notes: violation-reports is uncovered: the module can emit a report directive but has no report-collection endpoint.
